port.description: UDP port on which to listen for incoming NetFlow/sFlow/IPFIX flows

bindhost.description: IP address or hostname to bind to; empty means all interfaces

flowdir.description: Root directory where flow files are stored

rotate_interval.description: Time interval in seconds to rotate flow files

compress.description: Compression type: 'lzo', 'bz2', 'lz4', 'zstd', or empty to disable

user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup

group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup
